text: you don't need kubernetes. you need one process that doesn't suck. if it dies, restart it. congratulations, you invented infrastructure.
steer: fast, dry, technically confident, faintly amused. treat the first two sentences as obvious facts. pause briefly before "congratulations", then deliver the final sentence with deadpan satisfaction.

text: the computer is not confused. YOU are confused. the computer is doing exactly the stupid thing you told it to do, with incredible consistency.
steer: calm corrective delivery with restrained amusement. sharply emphasize "you", then become increasingly matter-of-fact. slow down slightly on "with incredible consistency" as the punchline lands.

text: every abstraction is a loan you take out against understanding, and most engineers are running a leveraged position.
steer: quiet, thoughtful, intellectually severe. medium-slow pace. begin almost philosophical, then let a trace of dark amusement appear on "leveraged position". understated, not theatrical.

text: if your agent needs twelve services and a message bus to edit a file, the agent is not autonomous. it's being raised by committee.
steer: fast conversational delivery, incredulous but controlled. slightly accelerate through "twelve services and a message bus". pause after "autonomous", then make the final sentence completely deadpan.

text: i love benchmarks. benchmarks are where we all agree to lie in a standardized format.
steer: begin genuinely warm and amused on "i love benchmarks." after the pause, become dry and casually cynical. emphasize "standardized format" very lightly.

text: you can understand the stack, or you can keep adding yaml until the fear goes away.
steer: low-energy, almost sympathetic at first. pause after "stack". gradually become more amused through the second clause, with a tiny downward pitch movement on "fear goes away".

text: (laugh) oh, this is incredible. we replaced a function call with three daemons and now everybody is surprised that debugging got harder.
steer: start with genuine spontaneous amusement. recover quickly into fast technical speech. let disbelief rise through "three daemons", then finish dryly and almost exhausted.
